notes: Neo4j 5 Community, single instance (causal clustering, CDC, online backup and read routing are Enterprise-only). Order items are CONTAINS relationships, categories a CHILD_OF tree, so graph_traversal and join_lookup are native. Built-in full-text (Lucene) and HNSW vector indexes; no native TTL or pub/sub.

secondary_index.title: Create a secondary index on a non-key field and use it
secondary_index.detail: CREATE INDEX on a node property (range/point/text/lookup)

compound_index.title: Compound / composite index over two fields
compound_index.detail: CREATE INDEX ... FOR (n:L) ON (n.a, n.b) composite index

unique_constraint.title: Unique constraint on a non-key field (duplicate rejected)

ttl_expiry.title: Native per-document/key expiry
ttl_expiry.detail: no native per-node TTL; APOC apoc.ttl or a scheduled job on an expiry property

geo_index.title: Geospatial index and radius query
geo_index.detail: point type + point.distance; POINT range index for bounding-box

partial_update.title: Update a single field without rewriting the document

atomic_increment.title: Server-side atomic numeric increment
atomic_increment.detail: SET n.x = n.x + 1 inside an auto-committed transaction -> [(363,)]

optimistic_concurrency.title: Compare-and-set / version or ETag-guarded write
optimistic_concurrency.detail: read version, SET guarded by WHERE in one tx -> [(1, 2)]

multi_doc_transaction.title: Multi-document / multi-key ACID transaction with rollback

tunable_consistency.title: Per-request consistency / write concern / read preference
tunable_consistency.detail: single-primary within a cluster; routing (WRITE->leader, READ->followers) but no per-write quorum knob

nested_query.title: Filter on a field inside a nested object
nested_query.detail: map properties / flattened; APOC for deep maps

array_operators.title: Query and update array-valued fields (contains, push)
array_operators.detail: list properties + IN / list comprehensions / UNWIND -> 1

server_side_join.title: Join / lookup between two collections inside the engine
server_side_join.detail: traversals ARE the join: MATCH patterns over relationships (index-free adjacency)

schema_validation.title: Server-enforced document schema / constraints
schema_validation.detail: existence/type/key constraints are Enterprise-only; Community has UNIQUE constraints only

change_streams.title: Change feed / watch / keyspace notifications
change_streams.detail: CDC is Enterprise-only (db.cdc.*); Community has no change feed

server_side_scripting.title: Stored procedures / Lua / JS / UDF executed by the server
server_side_scripting.detail: APOC procedures/functions + custom user-defined procedures (Java) -> APOC 5.26.30

pubsub.title: Publish/subscribe messaging built into the engine

explain_plan.title: Query plan / profile output for a query
explain_plan.detail: EXPLAIN / PROFILE returns the operator tree (NodeIndexSeek, Expand, ...)

bulk_import.title: Native bulk import path (bulk API, batch, COPY-like tool)
bulk_import.detail: UNWIND $rows batches (used here); LOAD CSV; neo4j-admin database import (offline, fastest)

large_document.title: Store and read back a 15 MB document / value
large_document.detail: 15 MB string property ok (default max is bounded by page/heap, not a fixed doc size)

read_from_replica.title: Client can direct reads to a replica / secondary
read_from_replica.detail: single instance in this lab (Enterprise causal cluster routes reads to secondaries via bolt+routing)

snapshot_backup.title: Online snapshot / backup command available
snapshot_backup.detail: Community: neo4j-admin database dump needs the database stopped (STOP DATABASE is rejected, so the server stops); online backup is Enterprise

incremental_backup.title: Incremental / differential backup (file- or segment-level)
incremental_backup.detail: differential backups are Enterprise (neo4j-admin database backup --type=differential)

pitr.title: Point-in-time recovery from a continuous change log
pitr.detail: Enterprise: full + differential backups restore to a transaction id; Community has full dumps only

slow_query_log.title: Server-side slow-query log with a configurable threshold
slow_query_log.detail: query.log (db.logs.query.threshold) stays empty in Community; the in-memory query collector db.stats.collect/retrieve('QUERIES') records every query with elapsed time (status: collecting)

audit_log.title: Audit / full-query log of statements or auth events
audit_log.detail: security.log auth events and query.log are Enterprise; Community has the query collector only

structured_logs.title: JSON-structured server log out of the box
structured_logs.detail: log4j2 (conf/server-logs.xml, user-logs.xml): switch the PatternLayout to JsonTemplateLayout; text by default

runtime_log_level.title: Change log verbosity at run time (no restart)
runtime_log_level.detail: conf/server-logs.xml is re-read every 30 s (log4j2 monitorInterval) — edit the Root level, no restart; dbms.setConfigValue is Enterprise

strategy.server_log: /logs/neo4j.log (user log, also stdout), /logs/debug.log (root logger, 20 MB x 7 rolling), query.log / security.log / http.log — log4j2 via conf/server-logs.xml + user-logs.xml
strategy.slow_query: db.logs.query.enabled + db.logs.query.threshold write query.log with parameters/page hits — Enterprise only in practice (accepted but empty in Community); Community: CALL db.stats.collect/retrieve('QUERIES') in-memory query collector
strategy.audit: security.log (authentication/authorization events) is Enterprise; no statement audit in Community
strategy.runtime: log4j2 monitorInterval=30: edit conf/server-logs.xml and the level changes within 30 s, no restart; dbms.setConfigValue is Enterprise
